notes: No output-quality gate was run, so the quality cost of the quantized KV cache is unmeasured. The A/B legs share one build and one prompt; only the cache dtype differs.
summary: Uniform 8-bit KV cache versus FP16 on a Qwen3-8B port, 8k prompt and 512 decode tokens, five alternating A/B pairs on an Apple M3 Max.
